standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-th.npc: The food you gave me healed my wounds, and it also reminded me of my family; that helped me to remember who I was.
I'm afraid that I'm trapped here, but I still remember something of this floor of the temple.
If you need any hints about the rooms nearby, I can give you some help.

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-th.player: It's okay, I don't need any help.
